title: BURLINGTON REVOLUTION MEN'S LEAGUE | WEEK 5 RECAP
content: Week 5 was a scorching one for the Burlington Revolution Men's League. Kevin Garrison nearly wrote his name into a triple-double to erase a 13-point deficit, Stefan Radan caught fire from every angle on the way to 40, Tavarius Vance and Black turned up the defense to run Green off the floor, and Blue's balanced attack kept its perfect season alive against Pink. Let's get into the action.

games.text: White had a point to prove. White came out attacking, leaning on Tyrone Conley's scoring punch and Devin Bradford's work on the interior to build an early cushion. Conley was money from the jump, and White's crisper ball movement had them dictating the pace. Kevin Garrison tried to answer for Purple possession for possession, but White's hot first-half shooting kept them in control heading into the break. Halftime: White 50, Purple 43. But Purple wasn't done making its case. Kevin Garrison took over out of the break, bulldozing his way to a stat line that touched every box on the score sheet. Dennis Schut heated up from beyond the arc, and Brody Snow cleaned the glass to give Purple extra possessions. Purple's defense flipped the switch and outscored White 54-37 after halftime to complete the turnaround. Purple pulled away late and closed it out, 97-87.

performers.White: Tyrone Conley — 29 pts; Kolby Bradford — 9 pts, 10 REB, 10 AST; Aid Semic — 13 pts, 11 REB
performers.Purple: Kevin Garrison — 32 pts, 19 REB, 10 AST; Dennis Schut — 22 pts; Brody Snow — 14 pts, 12 REB

games.text: Pink came ready to make a statement. Tavian Barrino was electric early, hunting his own shot and getting to the rim at will. Donnie Dwyer chipped in from all three levels, and Pink's pace advantage had Blue on its heels. Blue answered with balanced scoring from Brody Lathrop and Henry Cogswell, but Pink's first-half surge was enough to edge ahead heading into the break. Halftime: Pink 37, Blue 34. Blue had other plans for the second half. Drew Pelkey took control after the break, attacking downhill and knocking down shots from range, while Henry Cogswell and Logan Letourneau kept finding ways to score. Blue's defense tightened and forced Pink into tougher looks, and a 40-point second-half outburst flipped the game in Blue's favor. Blue closed it out, 74-61, staying unbeaten.

performers.Pink: Tavian Barrino — 28 pts; Donnie Dwyer — 16 pts, 10 REB; Matt Riordan — 11 pts, 9 REB, 5 AST
performers.Blue: Drew Pelkey — 21 pts; Brody Lathrop — 19 pts; Henry Cogswell — 18 pts

games.text: Black wanted to make its presence felt early. Green got off to a solid start behind Calder Horowitz-McCadden's shot-making and Nick Lynn's work on the glass, but Black answered every run. Tavarius Vance and Seth Jackson combined for a scoring punch Green couldn't match, and Black's pressure defense started forcing tough possessions on the other end. Halftime: Black 37, Green 30. Black had no intention of letting up. Tavarius Vance kept pouring it on, Will Ameden got in on the scoring, and Kaleb Swetty orchestrated the offense with a team-high six assists. Green's Nick Lynn and Wyatt Jarvis-Comi tried to keep pace, but Black's defense clamped down late, outscoring Green 40-29 in the second half. Black ran away with it, 77-59.

performers.Green: Calder Horowitz-McCadden — 21 pts; Nick Lynn — 18 pts, 12 REB; Wyatt Jarvis-Comi — 13 pts
performers.Black: Tavarius Vance — 28 pts; Will Ameden — 19 pts; Seth Jackson — 17 pts

games.text: Orange came out swinging from the opening tip. Stefan Radan was already heating up, splashing threes and getting to his spots against a Red defense that had no answer. Josh Carter facilitated beautifully, spraying the ball around for easy buckets, and Orange's balanced attack built a comfortable cushion. Chris Cayole tried to keep Red afloat with his scoring, but Orange controlled the tempo throughout the half. Halftime: Orange 33, Red 25. Orange only turned up the heat after the break. Stefan Radan went nuclear in the second half, connecting on shot after shot and finishing with a monster 40-point night. Josh Carter continued to set the table, and Orange's defense forced Red into rushed possessions all night. Chris Cayole fought hard to keep Red competitive, but a 51-point second-half outburst put the game out of reach. Orange cruised to the win, 84-62.

performers.Red: Chris Cayole — 31 pts; Jaren Jeffcoat — 12 pts, 8 REB; Will Oboh — 7 pts, 3 AST
performers.Orange: Stefan Radan — 40 pts; Josh Carter — 21 pts, 8 AST; Kenny Black — 9 pts
